description: Mail related to a commit, topic or PR. A postgres commit SHA (7-40 hex): the mail that refers to it (match_mode commit): Discussion: threads, then the committers announcement, then mail citing the hash, each with how_it_refers. Otherwise a case-insensitive substring of subjects and Message-IDs; no hit falls back to semantic search over every list.

query.description: Subject words, Message-ID substring or commit SHA

name: find_related_discussions
